cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and PhD candidate who has spent the last few years building and evaluating large language models for Turkish text summarisation and clinical AI. My work on hybrid automatic evaluation metrics required designing training curricula, mixing data sources, and running extensive experiments to compare extractive methods with LLMs. This mirrors the end-to-end research cycle you describe for robot foundation models.

At Toros University I led a department and co-founded the SmartLab Technology Center, where I managed projects that integrated AI models into real-world applications such as medical document summarisation and disinformation detection. Those projects demanded rigorous statistical analysis, reproducible pipelines, and performance optimisation in PyTorch.

I have contributed to several COST research networks, handling data management, privacy, and AI development for medical and image-based use cases. My recent publications on trustworthy AI and LLM-as-judge evaluation show a commitment to robust, transparent model assessment, which matches your focus on sample efficiency and reliability.

While I have not yet worked directly with robot hardware, I look forward to applying my expertise in large-scale model training and evaluation to the challenges of dexterous manipulation. I look forward to discussing how my research background can help build the intelligence layer you envision.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş

answers.relevant_experience: I have built and evaluated hybrid NLP models using PyTorch, designed data mixes for medical summarisation, and led a research centre that integrated AI into practical applications. My publications on trustworthy AI demonstrate strong statistical and experimental skills.
answers.research_interests: My research interests lie at the intersection of trustworthy AI, large language models, and their deployment in safety-critical domains. I aim to improve sample efficiency and robustness of models that interact with the physical world.
